journal.title: Mansalay: community and identity
journal.text: Act 3498 reestablished Mansalay and Bulalacao separately, effective 1 January 1929. Mansalay has 17 barangays in the PSA table dated 31 July 2025. Barangays are the local communities that make up the municipality or city. Provincial records document coconut farmer organizations and cacao planting support in Mansalay. Hanunoo Mangyan ambahan uses seven-syllable lines to express experiences and relationships. NCCA associates culture bearer Ginaw Bilog with this tradition in Mansalay. Farm soils and vegetation support cultivation. Caring for soil and water helps sustain agricultural livelihoods.
